arguments.command:
python -c "
import re
# Old pattern for {:<}
old_pattern = r'(.+?) *\$'
# New pattern
new_pattern = r'([^ ]+?) *\$'

test_strings = [
    'hello       ',  # trailing spaces (padding)
    'hello',         # no padding
    'hello world',   # space followed by more text
]

for s in test_strings:
    old_match = re.match(old_pattern, s)
    new_match = re.match(new_pattern, s)
    print(f'String: {repr(s)}')
    print(f'  Old: {old_match.group(1) if old_match else None}')
    print(f'  New: {new_match.group(1) if new_match else None}')
"
